summary: Frontend-only checks for the 3 text changes at 1440 and 375 widths. Everything passed. /app login: login-parent-link 'Sei un genitore? Accedi all'area pazienti' (href /portale) sits below login-submit-button and above login-signup-links (bounding boxes confirm the order). login-note reads 'Accesso protetto per i medici MantMed' (unchanged). login-subtitle reads 'Workspace clinico · Pediatria specialistica'. No horizontal overflow at 375. Clicking the link opens /portale with subtitle 'Portale Paziente · genitori e tutori' and no parent link. /portale opened directly also has no parent link. /admin has neither the parent link nor the signup links. /registrati/paziente shows the new labels and placeholders on inputs still named first_name/last_name. /registrati/medico still shows Nome/Cognome with es. Mario/es. Rossi. On /, document.title and the meta description match the new text exactly. Doctor login with medico@mantmed.it works and opens the dashboard. No registration was submitted.
critical_code_review_comments: Observation: the /area-riservata AccountGate login uses signup=true and parent=false, so it also shows the 'Sei un genitore?' link. This is harmless and consistent with the signup links shown there. Hide it if it should appear only on /app.
Optional: index.html has no og:title/og:description tags. Add them if you want social link previews.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Text changes verified in Login.jsx (parent prop and parent link), Register.jsx (parent field labels) and index.html (title/meta). Login used for routes: /app default, /portale parent, /admin signup=false, /area-riservata default.
